responsibility: This definition module declares the minimal GNU Modula-2 runtime entry points needed to link programs against the tiny gm2-libs-min runtime. It exposes the ABI for module construction/destruction, module registration and dependency reporting, initialization/termination sequencing, HALT, and a no-op exception-reporting hook, using SYSTEM.ADDRESS and the ArgCVEnvP callback type so compiled Modula-2 code can reference the expected runtime services even when only the smallest embedded-style runtime is present.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface half of the M2RTS pair: it declares the minimal runtime entry points and shared callback type that generated Modula-2 code imports, while the same-stem M2RTS.mod supplies the empty linker-satisfying implementations.
